## Hypothesis tests (frozen study, d = 128; Holm within each family; per-cell results in hypothesis_tests_cells.csv)

| hypothesis | cells | cells_favouring | sign_test_p | sig_after_holm |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| H1: spectral BCT is not better than random projection (d=128) | 32 | BCT better in 6/32 | 0.001 | 14 worse, 1 better |
| H2b: BCT is equivalent with permuted channel order (margin 0.5) | 32 | |diff| < 0.5 in 23/32 |  | equivalent in 1 |
| H3: KAN loses more than Linear under lossy reduction (frozen) | 32 | KAN loses more in 25/32 | 0.002 | 13 KAN-worse, 2 KAN-better |
| H4: LayerNorm helps the KAN under bct | 8 | KAN+LN better in 8/8 | 0.008 | 5 better, 0 worse |
| H4: LayerNorm helps the KAN under blockcirc | 8 | KAN+LN better in 7/8 | 0.070 | 0 better, 0 worse |
| H4: LayerNorm helps the KAN under pca | 8 | KAN+LN better in 7/8 | 0.070 | 4 better, 1 worse |
| H4: LayerNorm helps the KAN under random | 8 | KAN+LN better in 0/8 | 0.008 | 0 better, 2 worse |
